news.title: Register Now for ACE-IHEP Webinar on Preparing for New Federal Accountability Rules
news.summary_en: The webinar, “Preparing for Federal Earnings-Based Accountability: What Institutions and States Need to Know,” will be Nov. 19.

news.title: ACE, Higher Education Groups Urge IRS to Withdraw Rule Threatening Colleges' Tax-Exempt Status
news.summary_en: ACE and 40 other higher education associations are urging the IRS to withdraw a proposal that could strip private, nonprofit colleges and universities of their tax-exempt status.
